purpose: Determine whether V27 repaired the V26 latent calibration mechanism before designing the predeclared train-only empirical joint residual control.

audit_scope.latent_decomposition: the frozen six-level V27 orthonormal Haar transform and trained spline

recorded_diagnostics: truth and generated G21 latent moments, extrema, and absolute tail occupancy at 3, 4, 5, and 6
truth and generated standardized Haar-detail moments by coarse-to-fine scale
truth and generated trained-flow base-z moments by coarse-to-fine scale
trained-model forward/inverse latent roundtrip and log-determinant cancellation
one stored physical ensemble replay per object through the complete frozen inverse chain
scale-resolved NLL trajectory at steps 500, 10000, 20000, 25000, and 30000
V27 versus V26 final latent-support and first-two-scale base-z calibration

fixed_scores.coarse_base_z_score_per_domain: mean over the first two scales of abs(log(truth base-z standard deviation)); lower is better because the fitted base density is standard normal
fixed_scores.latent_support_score_per_domain: abs(log(generated/truth occupancy at abs(G21 latent)>=5)); lower is better
fixed_scores.strict_improvement: V27 score must be numerically lower than V26 for every development domain
fixed_scores.zero_occupancy_rule: add one pooled coefficient to numerator and denominator before forming an occupancy ratio only if either count is zero

fixed_classification_order.next: repair numerical inversion before any new statistical model

fixed_classification_order.condition: coarse base-z and latent-support scores strictly improve over V26 in every development domain
fixed_classification_order.next: audit the deterministic current-density backbone before changing the residual density family
freeze and test a train-only empirical joint residual control
